blocks.text: Liquid ke molecules ke darmiyan bain-al-molecular (intermolecular) quwwatein khasi mazboot hain. Yahan teen qismein bayan hain: instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (London dispersion forces), permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces, aur hydrogen bonding.

blocks.prompt: Is topic ki teen intermolecular forces ke naam batayein aur kahein ke in mein se kaun si argon, HCl aur pani ke molecules ke darmiyan kaam karti hain.
blocks.explanation: Forces London (instantaneous dipole-induced dipole) forces, permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces aur hydrogen bonding hain. Argon atoms mein sirf London forces hain. HCl molecules mein London forces ke saath dipole-dipole forces hain. Pani ke molecules mein dono ke ilawa hydrogen bonds hain.

items: Liquids mein teen intermolecular forces: instantaneous dipole-induced dipole (London), permanent dipole-permanent dipole, aur hydrogen bonding.
